name: Pervasive E2213KS0E1
description: 2.13-inch monochrome wide-temperature panel, 212 × 104; tentative 2023 electrical characterization.

pins.notes: Exact physical pin metadata and reviewed distributor-hosted manufacturer PDF are in characterization.json. The simulation uses one logical tied supply rail; separate rail power and booster pins are not simulated.

simulation.scope: Configurable full-refresh energy preset in preset.json. Panel and its display driver/reference circuit under cited test conditions; host MCU, radio, upstream converter, optional adapter board, touch and frontlight consumption are not included.
blockers: Idle power must be explicitly supplied before creating a runnable model. Refresh specification is tentative.
